creatives.suggested_headline: Stop paying for subscriptions you forgot
creatives.suggested_primary_text: Tally finds recurring charges quietly draining your account, then helps you cancel what you don't use.

qa_notes.readability_check: Overlay reads in one glance; dark text on light UI passes the thumbnail squint test.
qa_notes.native_platform_check: Reads like a real product screenshot, native to Meta feed; not stocky or corporate.
policy_risks: Dollar figures shown in the UI are illustrative sample data, not a specific user's result — keep them clearly representative, never presented as a testimonial.

creatives.recommended_next_iteration: Test a 1:1 variant and a version with the total in the upper third; A/B the headline against a question hook.

creatives.suggested_primary_text: Old free trials and forgotten subscriptions keep charging your card. Tally spots them so you can cancel in a tap.

qa_notes.readability_check: Single bold question reads instantly at the top; strong figure-ground contrast.
qa_notes.native_platform_check: Conceptual but candid; reads native to feed, not stocky.

creatives.recommended_next_iteration: Test a receipt-pile vs. a single glowing recurring charge; cut a 9:16 story variant.
